text: Here, the world feels modern and intentional, edged with the quiet promise of creation and thought. The glass, screens, and careful graphic design suggest a place dedicated to innovation or discovery. As I look at the exhibition wall bearing "R + D," I sense that I am in a temple of ideas—an incubator of futures. I feel a mild exhilaration, coupled with curiosity, as if I am on the threshold of something yet unnamed. It is a contemplative but optimistic presence.
